user_story: As a user, I want to be blocked from logging in if my account is locked so that security is enforced.

positive.title: User tries to log in with a locked account.
steps: User attempts to log in using locked account credentials.
Verify that the login request is sent.
positive.expected_result: User is displayed a message indicating the account is locked and is unable to log in.

negative.title: User attempts to log in with incorrect credentials on a locked account.
steps: User attempts to log in with incorrect username and password on a locked account.
negative.expected_result: User is displayed a message indicating incorrect credentials, but account remains locked.

edge.title: User tries to log in after the account is unlocked.
steps: User then attempts to log in with valid credentials.
edge.expected_result: User successfully logs in and accesses their account.
